title: Water Damage Mitigation Tear-Out Debris Haul-Off Line
content:
When pad, carpet or drywall comes out of a Water Damage Mitigation job, the debris leaving the property is billed to the job as a debris haul-off line in pickup-truck loads.

## Scope
The job must be in authorized, drying or drying complete status when a mitigation service line is charged. Every mitigation service line other than a tear-out debris haul-off line, a tear-out antimicrobial line and a final HEPA vacuuming line remains billed at the unit rate of the job's tier for its service code multiplied by the quantity performed: extraction, antimicrobial, pad and carpet work and HEPA vacuuming by the square foot, flood cuts and baseboard by the linear foot, contents manipulation by the room, debris by the load, PPE by the technician-day, labor by the hour, and moisture mapping, thermal imaging, containment, dumpster, lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling by the each; for a job's tear-out debris haul-off line, and only for that line, the loads and the per-load rate are set by the company's tear-out debris pricing, while the antimicrobial and final HEPA vacuuming lines are set by their own rules.

## Business effect
Booking the line adds one debris haul-off charge, in loads, to the job's charge list and raises the job's balance due by the line amount; the customer sees the line and the higher balance.

## Invoking the booking tool
`book_tearout_debris_a8b773d4` is an agent-side tool: the desk agent unlocks it and then calls it. The call books one debris haul-off charge line, billed in pickup-truck loads, on the named Water Damage Mitigation job. The tool records what it is given; it does not work out any value.

### Parameters
- `water_job_id` — the reference number of the water mitigation job the debris was removed from, as read from the water mitigation job lookup.
- `service_date` — the calendar date the debris haul-off line is dated, written YYYY-MM-DD with no time and no time zone; never empty.
- `loads` — the number of pickup-truck loads billed: a positive whole number of loads, with no fractional part.
- `unit_rate` — the per-load rate in USD, a positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up before the call.
- `amount` — the line amount in USD, a positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up before the call.

### Return
On success the tool returns a text receipt of the form "Booked debris haul-off charge <charge reference> on job <job reference>: <loads> load(s) at <per-load rate> ...", continuing with the line amount and the job's balance due after the line ("balance due now <balance> USD"); the charge reference is the new line's reference number and the amounts are USD with 2 decimals. The call has succeeded when the receipt starts with "Booked". A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: the date was not written YYYY-MM-DD, the loads were not a positive whole number, the rate or amount was not positive or carried more than 2 decimal places, or no water mitigation job has that reference number.
